elements.description: A smiling child sitting at a table eating from a plate of rice and dal
A round plate full of food in front of the child
A green leafy potted plant on a sunny windowsill next to the child
A bright yellow sun visible through the window outside

scenes.image_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration with bold dark outlines, simple bright greens, yellows and blues, on a pure white background, textbook-diagram style with no text. A child on the left side sitting at a table eating from a plate of food; on the right a green leafy potted plant on a windowsill; through the window at top right a bright yellow sun shines. All parts large and well separated.

elements.description: Branching roots of the plant spreading in brown soil at the bottom
Upright green stem carrying water upward
A broad green leaf on the upper side of the plant
A magnified circle inset of the leaf surface showing small bean-shaped pores (stomata)
Small grey clouds/molecules of carbon dioxide in the air on the left of the leaf

scenes.image_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration with bold dark outlines, simple bright greens, yellows and blues, on a pure white background, textbook-diagram style with no text. A whole plant: roots in brown soil at the bottom, a green stem, and broad leaves at the top. Grey carbon dioxide puffs float in the air to the left of a leaf. On the right, a magnified circular inset connected to the leaf shows the leaf surface with bean-shaped stomata pores. Parts large and well separated.

elements.description: A bright yellow sun in the top left corner
Yellow rays of light traveling from the sun to the leaf
A large green leaf in the center with visible veins
A magnified circle inset on the right showing leaf cells filled with small green oval chloroplasts

scenes.image_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration with bold dark outlines, simple bright greens, yellows and blues, on a pure white background, textbook-diagram style with no text. A bright yellow sun in the top left corner sends straight yellow rays onto a large green leaf in the center. On the right, a magnified circular inset linked to the leaf shows rectangular leaf cells packed with small green oval chloroplasts. Parts large and well separated.

elements.description: A large green leaf at the top of the plant in sunlight
A small white sugar-cube-like food symbol drawn inside the leaf
Plant stem and roots below, where food is stored
Light blue bubbles rising from the leaf into the air above

scenes.image_prompt: Clean flat vector illustration with bold dark outlines, simple bright greens, yellows and blues, on a pure white background, textbook-diagram style with no text. elements.description: A small green leaf with a little yellow sun above it
A small sugar-cube food symbol with blue oxygen bubbles beside it
